_what: How read-data/hear-here.mjs (tool:hear-a-link) turns a link to a video or a recording into its words on the person's computer. `fetchers` are the link readers, tried in order: the first whose program is the one the person gave (`link_reader`) or is found in its `search_path`, then PATH, is used. Each has `info` (prints the page's facts as JSON), `captions` (writes the captions the page offers, in `languages`, into {folder}) and `sound` (writes the sound alone into {folder}); every value in braces is filled when it runs ({url}, {folder}, {languages}, {node}: the node program running this, which some pages need to be read). `languages` are the caption languages asked for when the AI names none. Captions win when the page has them; otherwise the sound is heard with whisper-cli through do-work/audio_transcription.py. `keep_sound` keeps that sound in the person's files (`folder`, named by the page's title) with its words beside it as <name>.words.json, so it is found by search and never fetched again. `most_minutes` is the longest the fetch may take. Every word the AI reads is under `words`; a link with no words is always answered with why. Moved from the product repo's computer/hear-a-link.json and records/hear-fetcher-records.json (the yt-dlp row, without its channel `list`, which computer/list-a-channel.mjs still reads there).

confine._what: When enabled, the link reader (a program that fetches a page from the internet) runs confined by the Seatbelt runner of tools/run-on-a-persons-computer (from-old-trillion/computer/confined-run.mjs) under this tier: it can write only in its working folder. Off until switched on.

words.needs_url: Send the link to a video or a recording as url.
words.no_fetcher: This computer has no program that reads video links (such as yt-dlp), so the words could not be read from {url}.
words.no_hearing: {url} has no captions, and no Whisper model was given (model_path), so its sound could not be turned into words.
words.fetch_failed: Could not read {url} on this computer: {error}
words.stale_fetcher: Could not read {url} on this computer: {error}. The page refused this computer's copy of {fetcher}; updating it often fixes this ({hint}).
words.no_words: {url} was read and heard whole on this computer, but nobody speaks in it, so it has no words.
words.captions_by: captions on the page, read on this computer
words.needs_file: Give `file`: the recording's name or identity in the person's files.
words.needs_model: Give model_path: the ggml Whisper model file on this computer.
words.too_large: {file} is {size} bytes, more than one run reads.
